a: A walk started below the top marks an `'inherit'` paint as carried by a group that is never written, so the serializer drops it
A built-in leaf's `'world'` (and `'screen'`) gradient or pattern turns and skews with the node's pose, though the canvas holds it still in scene space
The root `<svg>`'s size is read two ways: as the viewport for percentages and as the media environment for `@media` / `@container`
b: A `'world'`-units gradient or pattern on a leaf whose pose has a `transform` is moved by that transform on export
A one-value `dx` is thrown away whenever the text has collapsible white space, though `dy` and `rotate` keep theirs
A percentage length under a root `<svg>` with no `viewBox` and no absolute size has "no viewport", while media and container queries size that same root 300 × 150
`raiseRuns` misplaces rises when the first run it reaches holds earlier glyphs; `turnRuns` handles the same case
